question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word: QUIXOTIC
solution: The correct answer is: **Realistic**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Quixotic"** means exceedingly idealistic; unrealistic and impractical. (अवास्तविक और अप्रासंगिक रूप से आदर्शवादी) • **Example:** His plan to save the world by planting a million trees in one week was quixotic. • **"Realistic"** refers to having a sensible and practical idea of what can be achieved or expected. (व्यावहारिक) • **Example:** She has a realistic approach to managing her finances, which helps her save money effectively. • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"Quixotic"** is **"Realistic"**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Realistic**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Idealistic** (आदर्शवादी): Characterized by idealism; unrealistically aiming for perfection. • **Example:** His idealistic vision of the future often clashed with the harsh realities of life. • **Imaginative** (काल्पनिक): Having or showing creativity or inventiveness. • **Example:** The artist’s imaginative portrayal of the landscape captivated everyone. • **Dreamlike** (स्वप्न जैसा): Having a surreal, unreal, or magical quality, as if in a dream. • **Example:** The scenery was so beautiful that it felt dreamlike. 36:Taa3, The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
